newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Ex-Im Bank, others lend $250 mln to Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: Japan Ex-Im Bank, others lend $250 mln to Petrobras.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Tuesday that it and seven Japanese commercial banks, had agreed to lend a total of $250 million to Petroleo Brasileiro SA (Petrobras).
The proceeds will be used to upgrade Petrobras's facility at its Bahia refinery in order to boost gasoline and diesel oil production, the bank said in a statement.
The Ex-Im Bank said it would provide 16.5 billion yen, equivalent to 60 percent of the total amount, and the rest would be co-financed by seven commercial banks, led by Sakura Bank.
In February, Mitsui & Co Ltd agreed to provide a 120 billion yen loan to Petrobras for the same project, it said.
